Question 2
?

Consider the arc of the curve x=ey that lies between y=0 and y=1, as shown above. What integral gives the area of the surface generated when this arc is rotated 2π radians about the y-axis?

a
2π∫01ey1+e2ydy
b
π∫01y1+e2ydy
c
2π∫01ey1+2e2ydy
d
2π∫01(e2y+1)1+eydy
e
π∫011+e2ydy
